ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips, resulting in a high-contrast ratio of approximately 1:6.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling and marbling are localized to the upper outer margins (distal tips) of both lobes; the central and proximal regions are contiguous low-intensity black with sparse pixel-level noise.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a wide obtuse angle of approximately 120 degrees and a shallow pixel-depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; right lobe (viewer perspective) shows higher amplitude peaks and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe which exhibits a more uniform micro-serration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across the lower quadrants of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, including a prominent diagonal rake mark near the mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique jagged, irregular pixel boundary at the extreme right distal tip compared to the relatively smoother left distal tip.
